ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://citl.illinois.edu. Students with a partial time conflict (such as those enrolling in the 2nd 8-week NRES 598 on Thursdays), may be able to receive a time conflict override. Please contact Dr. Hudson at rjhudson@illinois.edu to discuss your situation. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions.
